title: offerResponse
description: Object with response to carrier offer.

loadNumber.description: ID of the shipment the offer was made on.

carrierCode.description: C.H. Robinson defined code for the carrier making the offer.

offerRequestId.description: Unique identifier that is associated with the offer request. This is the ID received in the response when making the offer.

offerId.description: C.H. Robinson's internal id associated to the offer.

offerResult.description: Current status of the offer. Rejected and NotConsidered can both be considered declining the offer. Counter means C.H. Robinson has countered with a new price.

price.description: Price of the offer. If the offerResult is "Counter" then the price displayed is C.H. Robinson's counter offer price.

currencyCode.description: Currency code of the offer amount.

rejectReasons.description: If offer is rejected this details the reason(s).
